verdict.rationale: Supabase's branching feature (docs-26, docs-36) creates isolated preview environments that spin off from the main project to test schema/config changes without affecting production, which covers the 'schema' and 'instant branch' parts of the story. However, the evidence never confirms copy-on-write cloning of actual production *data* into branches, and community commentary (supabase-comm-5, supabase-comm-6, supabase-comm-7) highlights ongoing friction with migrations/local dev workflows, with the CEO referencing upcoming 'Preview Databases' as a future fix rather than a fully solved capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of production-data cloning into branches, and independent confirmation that branches contain real production-shaped data rather than just schema/config.
